rationale: The plan correctly stops at sample-structure QC for the 6 vs 6 unpaired single-batch design: blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes with PC1/PC2 variance, Euclidean distance heatmap coloured by condition, per-sample library size, detected genes, top-gene fractions and size factors, plus a keep-inspect-report policy for sample_01 argued on depth-shaped versus condition-shaped deviation, a leave-one-out PCA, and the PC1-depth correlation. Normalization is left to DESeq2 size factors on counts as delivered, with the Salmon length-correction ambiguity recorded rather than patched. The clear gap is the absence of any stated low-count gene filter before the VST and PCA; the only filtering language concerns keeping all samples. Model, FDR, and enrichment are appropriately omitted with the omission stated, and the report specifies method, design, thresholds and caveats, though package versions are not named.
